item.title: Wagahai wa Oyome-san de Aru ~Oku-sama wa Oshiego JK!~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: FIANCEE
  • 発売日: 2012-04-27
  • スコア: 6.21/10 (24 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 吾輩はお嫁サンである ～奥サマは教え子JK！～
  • 英語名: Wagahai wa Oyome-san de Aru Oku-sama wa Oshiego JK!

あらすじ

Kurogane Akira has recently graduated from college and is looking for work. However in the modern economy it’s difficult for him to find a job. A mysterious stranger introduces himself as a friend of his father’s with a job offer from a nearby school. His father pressures him to take the job to support his fiancee Mutsumi who was betrothed to him by their families. It seems Akira’s life is decided for him.

item.title: Miinasan, Kakkee Desu! -Love Icha Doukyo Seikatsu no Susume-
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: FIANCEE
  • 発売日: 2011-05-27
  • スコア: 6.83/10 (54 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 美衣菜△です！－Loveイチャ同居生活のススメ－
  • 英語名: Miinasan, Kakkee Desu! -Love Icha Doukyo Seikatsu no Susume-

别名

  • みいなさん、かっけーです！－Loveイチャ同居生活のススメ－

あらすじ

This is the debut game for FIANCEE. Yuusaku confessed to Miina and they became lovers. She was an ojousama who had lived a sheltered life, but now they will be living together. However, it doesn’t all go smoothly, with their neighbours being suspicious of them, their classmates learning about them living together and other love rivals appearing. It also doesn’t help that he doesn’t understand girls well nor does she understand boys. The only thing that works to their favour is their strong love for each other. Will that be enough to overcome all their obstacles and come to a happy end?
